I am an old man now, 77 years, and I have farmed this land all my life like my father did. I own this plot so I put the manure from my goats on it every year — that is what keeps the soil alive. This year I got the coupon from the government again, so I will buy one bag of 23-21-0 and one bag of urea for the maize, and I will use the hybrid seed they sell with the coupon because my neighbors say it gives more cobs. My sons and their wives help me now because my back is not strong, and at weeding time I pay two young men from the village to help for a few days.
